_comment: Default pattern set for glossary_detector.py. Edit this file to tune per-project.

patterns.name: complete_suffix
patterns.description: snake_case identifiers ending with _complete (e.g. backfill_complete, setup_complete)

patterns.name: phase_number
patterns.description: phase followed by a digit, optionally with underscore (e.g. phase1, phase_2)

patterns.name: camel_case_prose
patterns.description: camelCase identifiers in prose (e.g. candleHorizon in a comment)
